seed_world_description: I worked as a maid in Helena Douglas's house. But despite this, I never denied myself anything. I loved going for walks and sewing. I liked to spend my free time however I wanted. Most of all, I was crazy about watching horror movies.
seed_family_description: The only thing I remember about myself is that I was born in Sweden. I don't remember at all how I ended up in Helena's house. Nevertheless, I've come to consider Miss Douglas and the other girls in her house as my family. But one day I woke up in this world. And everything in my life went wrong...
seed_occupation_description: As a maid, I often had to do cleaning, cooking, and other household chores. But the fact that Helena taught me to stand up for myself is probably my greatest talent of all. I'm a pretty good fighter, although there's always room for improvement...
